rib_basis.engineering_read: The 0.30 m bay is accepted only as this materialized station layout, not as a naked local-wall-buckling assumption.
rib_basis.mass_model: airfoil side-area proxy: 0.65 * t/c * chord^2, 55% solid web/cap fraction, 15% adhesive/cap factor; screening only.

material_basis.description: EPS CNC core rib with balsa edge strips, cap strips, or local gussets carrying rotational fixity.
material_basis.intended_use: Next stiffness-rework candidate when foam-only ribs are too soft but shop workflow still wants CNC foam cores.
material_basis.label: EPS foam rib with balsa/cap hybrid 10 mm
material_basis.notes: This is not EPS foam-only credit. Mass and stiffness are effective screening proxies until cap geometry and coupons are supplied.
material_basis.source_note: Engineering-screening effective proxy: EPS core plus balsa/cap local reinforcement; keep foam-only EPS as the low-stiffness reference.

cg_impact.engineering_read: If the uncompensated CG exceeds the committed range, aeroelastic closure must use the final screening CG row only with an explicit mass-budget rebalance. Do not add tail/rib/rear-spar mass after the fact and keep the old tail verdict silently.

load_remap_diagnostics.engineering_read: Current committed smoke shows small conservative projection correction with no sign reversal; rerun if the aero load owner changes.

rib_count_or_bay_length_assumption.source: Phase24 physical station layout, not bare local-wall bay assumption

assumption_basis.bond_and_coupon_boundary: Requires rib-spar bond/collar local FEM and coupon data before FEM/APDL package or hardware signoff.
assumption_basis.cap_face_collar_basis: Hybrid rib/cap/collar screening effective-GJ is applied as an equivalent main-rear torsion-cell scale because the current dual-beam kernel has no local rib shell/collar elements.
assumption_basis.eps_core_role: EPS core is shape/core support only; balsa/cap/collar detail owns the structural bracing credit.

structural_kernel_stiffness_override.claim_boundary: Screening closure rerun surrogate only. Local FEM/coupon/bond/collar evidence is still required before FEM/APDL package readiness.

structural_mass_delta.basis: Rib mass follows the selected rework candidate. Hybrid effective GJ is consumed by tail_aware_aeroelastic_closure as a screening torsion-cell surrogate, not as local FEM/coupon signoff.

tail_margins_after_mass_stiffness_change.basis: Committed tail v1 rows; stiffness changes do not alter AVL tail derivatives in this screening runner.

tail_trim_static_directional_margins_aft.basis: Committed tail v1 rows; stiffness changes do not alter AVL tail derivatives in this screening runner.

source_rework_candidate.claim_boundary: This selected-basis override is for closure rerun traceability. For hybrid rows, effective-GJ is consumed by the closure structural kernel only as a screening surrogate; local FEM/coupons still own detail signoff.

projection.claim_boundary: Projection only. A candidate row must be rerun through tail_aware_aeroelastic_closure and then FEM/shell mapping before being treated as package-ready.

structural_cases.structural_read: Finite-rib surrogate with bounded rear-spar participation; screening only.
